The 2027 Summit will feature: 90+ sessions, ranging from tutorials and case studies to panel discussions and leading research developments including: Vision-language model advancements, development tools and applications Embedded vision and deep learning techniques, technologies and opportunities Multiple expert sessions on deep learning for vision, 3D perception and low-power vision implementation Four tracks tailored for engineers and business executives, newcomers and experts Keynotes by thought leaders from industry and academia Deep Dive Day on Thursday, February 4, with in-depth learning from top technology suppliers Two vision-language model (VLMs) trainings on Thursday, February 4: an intro training covering the latest techniques in VLMs and their integration with traditional computer vision methods, and an advanced training on using VLMs for video understanding and agentic AI. See technology in action with over 60+ exhibitors showing live demos of the latest enabling technologies–the Summit is known for having terrific demos! Plenty of networking opportunities for building connections with speakers and other attendees February 2–4, 2027 Moscone West 800 Howard Street San Francisco, California 94103 The premier conference for innovators incorporating computer vision and physical AI in products Expect Inspiration Last year's attendees picked up some great ideas from the Summit. You can too! I always get a lot out of the Summit. There really is something for everyone. VP Automotive Practice - Strategy Analytics Great event! Very useful presentations and great demonstrations. I learned a lot and met great companies. Sensor Research Project Manager - Group SEB You Belong Here If You're... In Leadership: Chief Technical Officer, CEO, VP of Product Development, Chief Innovation Officer… In Engineering: Engineer, Systems Architect, Software Developer, Solutions Architect… In Marketing: Product Manager, Marketing Manager, Product Owner, Sales, Business Development… Many attendees tell us they have met colleagues in their own companies they’ve never met before, finding great ways to collaborate! The one thing they all have in common is that they are working to make great products using computer vision and physical AI. The Summit helps them do just that.
